name: Central Park
desc: 843 acres of free. Nap on a rock, people-watch by the pond, pretend the rent around you isn't $4k.

name: Brooklyn Bridge
desc: Walk it at 2 AM when it's just you, the cables, and a skyline that owes you nothing. Costs zero.

name: Times Square
desc: A million watts of ads screaming at you for free. Once in your life, be the person standing still in it.

name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art
desc: Five thousand years of humanity under one roof. Get lost until they kick you out at closing.

name: Statue of Liberty
desc: The ferry ride alone is worth it — salt air, harbor wind, and the green lady getting bigger and bigger.

name: Empire State Building
desc: Yes it's touristy. Yes you'll stand at the top at night and feel like the main character anyway.

name: The High Line
desc: An old train line turned sky garden. Float above the traffic for thirty blocks without spending a dime.

name: Chelsea Market
desc: Free to wander, dangerous to smell. Window-shop the tacos and lobster rolls until payday hits.

name: MoMA
desc: Stand in front of Starry Night and let it fix something in you. Worth every saved-up dollar.
